## Career Impact

### iVP Semiconductor — Product & Content Marketing Lead (Mar 2026–Present)
Founding product marketing hire at a fabless semiconductor startup spanning power MOSFETs, IGBTs, DC-DC converters, solid-state relays and IoT connectivity.
- Established the product marketing function from the ground up, including positioning, messaging, pricing and commercialization strategy.
- Conducted 15+ structured OEM discovery interviews across renewable energy, EV infrastructure and industrial automation; translated findings into ICP definition, segmentation, roadmap prioritization and launch sequencing.
- Led GTM planning and commercialization for 5+ launches; resume attributes ₹8+ Cr qualified pipeline, 30+ customer engagements and 10+ design opportunities to this work.
- Created 10+ product briefs, application notes, datasheets, battle cards, landing pages and customer-facing assets.
- Built and enabled a three-partner distributor ecosystem through onboarding, technical training, joint GTM and co-marketing.

### Millennium Semiconductors — Associate Manager, Principal Lines (Nov 2025–Feb 2026)
Channel-side product marketing and business development across Quectel (cellular/IoT), Digi International (embedded wireless), Inpaq and Semtech.
- Supported 75+ OEM accounts across EV, industrial automation, smart cities and connected devices.
- Managed a ₹123 Cr annual billing portfolio and ₹180 Cr design-in pipeline, as stated in the supplied resume.
- Delivered 10+ confirmed customer design wins through solution positioning, technical engagement, commercial negotiations and collaboration with suppliers, FAEs and OEM engineering teams.
- Translated Quectel LTE/5G and Digi XBee portfolios into application-focused positioning, evaluation strategies, pricing proposals and tender responses.

### Silicon Labs — Product Manager II (Apr 2022–Oct 2025)
Outbound product marketing, IoT & Wireless BU; product families included EFR32FG28 Sub-GHz, EFR32FG25 Wi-SUN, EFM8/EFM32 and EFR32 SoCs. First Product Manager II hire in India.
- Owned outbound global GTM strategy for the EFR32FG28 Sub-GHz SoC, including positioning, competitive messaging and sales enablement; resume records 10+ confirmed design wins during 23% YoY product-line growth.
- Led positioning, pricing and competitive strategy across a 300+ SKU, $1B+ 8-bit/32-bit MCU and wireless SoC portfolio.
- Led the EFR32FG25 Wi-SUN platform launch for smart metering and smart-city infrastructure through webinars, field events, technical enablement and regional campaigns.
- Translated cost-sensitivity feedback from 100+ customer engagements into a roadmap decision to right-size security features for price-sensitive segments, lowering BOM cost.
- Converted global tradeshow and competitive intelligence into positioning and next-generation roadmap input; produced 15+ launch assets supporting design-in closure.

### L&T Technology Services — Engineer (Aug 2018–Sep 2020)
Embedded product engineering focused on hardware design, cost optimization and product validation.
- Optimized component costs by 18% through BOM optimization, value engineering and alternate sourcing across embedded hardware programs.
- Reduced field recalls by 35% through failure analysis, test-methodology redesign and cross-functional quality improvements.
- Supported 6+ products from development through customer acceptance.
- Coordinated 50+ engineers and project leads across design, test and supply-chain functions.
